standards.name: Defining N-ary Relations on the Semantic Web

principles.contract: Decision form, refusal, latency and proper-score measurements remain separate from semantic correctness and causal credit.
principles.extension: A typed output contract does not implement permitted Step/Learn or semantic revision.

principles.contract: Keep held-out outcome, calibration sample, model/relation version and evidence mass distinct.
principles.extension: Calibration is not outcome-bound canonical revision, truth, causal credit or learning.

principles.contract: Independent reads may share a frozen snapshot only with declared dependency and revision ordering.
principles.extension: Parallel scheduling does not establish shared computation, serializable writes or joint semantics.

principles.contract: Measure candidate recall, none/expand and information sufficiency against fixed-topology controls.
principles.extension: Candidate construction does not discover topology or demonstrate adequate local information.

principles.contract: Represent role-bearing joint candidates or explicit factorization assumptions; test excluded states.
principles.extension: Marginal predictions do not establish a learned joint Semantic Weight disposition.

principles.contract: Measure lower and upper interventions, lineage, exit and calibration under one typed contract.
principles.extension: Nested graphs or wrappers do not establish fractal cognition-bearing composition.

work.name: Local semantic execution
work.dependencies: Priority diagnostic: frozen relation version; oracle/frozen/meaning-removed and role/exception interventions; equal information, model and cost; refusal-aware accuracy and probability-quality measurements.
work.failure_reroute: If oracle relations still fail, retain the failure, change information/encoding/model realization under a new protocol, and hold downstream topology/scale expansion.

work.name: Outcome revision separation
work.dependencies: May diagnose in parallel with W1: semantic delta, evidence delta, request delta; evidence-only/sham/remove/restore controls and fresh-process reuse. Any learning-efficacy judgment depends on an executable W1 condition.
work.failure_reroute: If no semantic delta is observable, preserve the no-op; byte change alone is not success, and reroute to explicit revision mediation.

work.name: Local-read and candidate sufficiency
work.dependencies: May diagnose in parallel with W1: controlled full-context/fixed-read/adaptive-read budgets, candidate recall, none/expand and added-read cost; hidden outcomes remain unread.
work.failure_reroute: If local reads alias distinct correct states or candidate recall is inadequate, correct the read/candidate contract and retest; confidence is not sufficiency.

work.name: Joint and batched execution
work.dependencies: Required W1–W3 conditions; allowed joint transitions and exclusion/complementarity/triple constraints; equal-cost serial/batch/actual-shared-compute protocol.
work.failure_reroute: If factorization violates a joint constraint or batching yields stale revisions, retain the failure and use explicit joint candidates or serialized stages; speed alone is not shared computation.

work.name: Two-scale composition
work.dependencies: W4 and both-scale typed Step/Learn, outcome, lineage, permission, conflict and exit witnesses.
work.failure_reroute: If lower-scale effects or contracts fail to persist at upper scale, do not use downstream scale to rescue them; preserve the failure and revise the composition mechanism.

data_contracts.name: RelationVersion
data_contracts.minimum_fields: schema version; lineage; atom UID; revision; schema-relative owner; semantic text; disposition; exception and evidence references
data_contracts.distinction: Stored meaning is distinct from role/context-conditioned transition disposition.

data_contracts.name: RoleParticipation
data_contracts.minimum_fields: relation version; exact participant atom version; role; reference type; slot or ordinal
data_contracts.distinction: Role exchange is distinct from enumeration-order change.

data_contracts.name: ReadFrame
data_contracts.minimum_fields: source snapshot; actual read-set and payload hash; context; omitted and added read requests
data_contracts.distinction: Small input size is distinct from information sufficiency.

data_contracts.name: DecisionContract / CandidateSet
data_contracts.minimum_fields: output type; ordered candidates; contract version; candidate scope; other/expand meaning
data_contracts.distinction: Candidate-normalized probability is distinct from candidate omission.

data_contracts.name: Execution / Prediction
data_contracts.minimum_fields: execution ID; frame; model/config; contract; request bytes; prediction; probability; refusal; cost
data_contracts.distinction: Repeated-call occurrence is distinct from equal content hash.

data_contracts.name: Outcome
data_contracts.minimum_fields: prediction or trace reference; observation source; event and record time; evaluation population
data_contracts.distinction: Observed outcome is distinct from prediction and self-explanation.

data_contracts.name: CalibrationArtifact
data_contracts.minimum_fields: fit population and split; model/relation/contract versions; method; temperature; evaluation scope
data_contracts.distinction: Calibration parameter is distinct from semantic revision and causal credit.

data_contracts.name: RevisionProposal / CommittedRevision
data_contracts.minimum_fields: parent version; bound trace and outcome; proposal; validation; commit result; semantic and evidence deltas
data_contracts.distinction: Proposed, stored, semantic change and useful improvement are distinct.
